enchant_guidance.label: Should Rogue DPS Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
enchant_guidance.text: For Rogues, choosing your Shattrath faction either  or  doesn't make that big of a difference in terms of raid performance. The main longstanding benefit will be the shoulder enchants from these factions.  from  is very slightly better than  from , but it is such a minuscule difference that you are unlikely to ever notice it. You will do just fine choosing whichever faction you prefer.
